messages.content:
Based on your interest in AI, CityUHK offers several specialized programmes. Below are the best matches with explanations, comparisons, and fee guidance.

---

### **Programme 1: MSc Artificial Intelligence (P75)**
**Why it fits:**
- This is the most direct and comprehensive AI programme, designed specifically for computer professionals who want to strengthen technical capabilities in AI.
- Covers core AI topics (10 credits) and a wide range of electives (21 credits), with optional streams in **Autonomous Driving**, **Generative AI**, and **Trustworthy AI**—allowing you to specialize.
- Prepares you for research, advanced development, or further AI studies.
- Eligible for the **Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship** (for local students under STEM priority).

**Best for:** Someone with a computing background who wants deep technical AI expertise.

---

### **Programme 2: MSc Artificial Intelligence in Business (P85)**
**Why it fits:**
- Designed for students with IT/IS or business backgrounds to build a holistic “AI + business” mindset.
- Combines AI core courses (e.g., Generative AI for Business, AI Ethics) with business core courses (e.g., Fintech, Marketing Analytics, People Analytics).
- Emphasizes using AI to improve efficiency, manage AI projects, and drive digital transformation.
- Offers a **HK$50,000 scholarship** for outstanding applicants and is also eligible for the UGC Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship (Digital priority).

**Best for:** Someone interested in applying AI to solve business problems and take on management/technical roles.

---

### **Programme 3: MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sciences (P79)**
**Why it fits:**
- Provides rigorous AI foundational training while enabling interdisciplinary knowledge across various scientific fields.
- Core courses include Statistical Machine Learning, Generative AI, and AI for Scientific Knowledge Discovery.
- Offers four tracks (e.g., AI for Scientific Discovery) to align with your scientific interests.
- Prepares graduates to develop novel AI algorithms and apply them to challenges in sciences and research.

**Best for:** Someone with a science background (or interest in science) who wants to use AI for research and innovation.

---

### **Programme 4: MSc AI-Driven Innovation (P89)**
**Why it fits:**
- Focuses on AI as both an **enabler** of innovation (using AI tools) and an **intelligent feature** in new products/services.
- Core courses cover Technological Innovation & Entrepreneurship, Design Science, and AI concepts/application.
- Emphasises systems design thinking and entrepreneurial leadership – ideal for leading the 4th Industrial Revolution.
- Electives allow you to tailor your learning toward innovation-driven projects.

**Best for:** Someone who wants to become a leader in technology innovation and entrepreneurship, blending AI with design and business strategy.

---

### **Comparison when multiple options exist**

| Aspect | MSc AI | MSc AI in Business | MSc AI for Sciences | MSc AI-Driven Innovation |
|--------|--------|-------------------|-------------------|--------------------------|
| **Primary focus** | Technical AI depth | AI + business management | AI + scientific research | AI + innovation/entrepreneurship |
| **Target background** | Computing / IT | IT/IS or business | Science / engineering | Any background with innovation interest |
| **Course structure** | Core + electives (with streams) | AI core + business core + electives | Core + track electives | Core + electives |
| **Scholarships** | UGC STEM Scholarship | UGC Digital Scholarship + HK$50,000 | Not mentioned | Not mentioned |

**Recommendation:**  
- If you want **the most technical, AI-specialised programme**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence**.  
- If you prefer **applying AI to business and leadership**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence in Business**.  
- If you have a **science background and want to solve scientific problems with AI**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sciences**.  
- If you aim to **become an innovator/entrepreneur using AI**, choose **MSc AI-Driven Innovation**.

---

### **How much should you pay?**
The retrieved context does **not include tuition fee information** for the above AI programmes. However, you can expect fees similar to other CityUHK taught postgraduate programmes (e.g., MSc Cybersecurity: HK$10,800–$12,300 per credit; MSc Finance: HK$11,700 per credit).  

**To get exact fees:**  
- Visit the official programme website for each programme.  
- Note that the **MSc AI** and **MSc AI in Business** programmes offer scholarships (as highlighted above) – check eligibility for fee reduction.  

For a general idea, most CityUHK MSc programmes require 30–36 credits, so total tuition could range from **~HK$324,000 to ~HK$421,000** (based on HK$10,800–$11,700 per credit), but this is an estimate only. Confirm with the latest fee schedule available on the CityUHK website.

Based on your interest in AI, CityUHK offers several specialized programmes. Below are the best matches with explanations, comparisons, and fee guidance.

---

### **Programme 1: MSc Artificial Intelligence (P75)**
**Why it fits:**
- This is the most direct and comprehensive AI programme, designed specifically for computer professionals who want to strengthen technical capabilities in AI.
- Covers core AI topics (10 credits) and a wide range of electives (21 credits), with optional streams in **Autonomous Driving**, **Generative AI**, and **Trustworthy AI**—allowing you to specialize.
- Prepares you for research, advanced development, or further AI studies.
- Eligible for the **Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship** (for local students under STEM priority).

**Best for:** Someone with a computing background who wants deep technical AI expertise.

---

### **Programme 2: MSc Artificial Intelligence in Business (P85)**
**Why it fits:**
- Designed for students with IT/IS or business backgrounds to build a holistic “AI + business” mindset.
- Combines AI core courses (e.g., Generative AI for Business, AI Ethics) with business core courses (e.g., Fintech, Marketing Analytics, People Analytics).
- Emphasizes using AI to improve efficiency, manage AI projects, and drive digital transformation.
- Offers a **HK$50,000 scholarship** for outstanding applicants and is also eligible for the UGC Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship (Digital priority).

**Best for:** Someone interested in applying AI to solve business problems and take on management/technical roles.

---

### **Programme 3: MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sciences (P79)**
**Why it fits:**
- Provides rigorous AI foundational training while enabling interdisciplinary knowledge across various scientific fields.
- Core courses include Statistical Machine Learning, Generative AI, and AI for Scientific Knowledge Discovery.
- Offers four tracks (e.g., AI for Scientific Discovery) to align with your scientific interests.
- Prepares graduates to develop novel AI algorithms and apply them to challenges in sciences and research.

**Best for:** Someone with a science background (or interest in science) who wants to use AI for research and innovation.

---

### **Programme 4: MSc AI-Driven Innovation (P89)**
**Why it fits:**
- Focuses on AI as both an **enabler** of innovation (using AI tools) and an **intelligent feature** in new products/services.
- Core courses cover Technological Innovation & Entrepreneurship, Design Science, and AI concepts/application.
- Emphasises systems design thinking and entrepreneurial leadership – ideal for leading the 4th Industrial Revolution.
- Electives allow you to tailor your learning toward innovation-driven projects.

**Best for:** Someone who wants to become a leader in technology innovation and entrepreneurship, blending AI with design and business strategy.

---

### **Comparison when multiple options exist**

| Aspect | MSc AI | MSc AI in Business | MSc AI for Sciences | MSc AI-Driven Innovation |
|--------|--------|-------------------|-------------------|--------------------------|
| **Primary focus** | Technical AI depth | AI + business management | AI + scientific research | AI + innovation/entrepreneurship |
| **Target background** | Computing / IT | IT/IS or business | Science / engineering | Any background with innovation interest |
| **Course structure** | Core + electives (with streams) | AI core + business core + electives | Core + track electives | Core + electives |
| **Scholarships** | UGC STEM Scholarship | UGC Digital Scholarship + HK$50,000 | Not mentioned | Not mentioned |

**Recommendation:**  
- If you want **the most technical, AI-specialised programme**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence**.  
- If you prefer **applying AI to business and leadership**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence in Business**.  
- If you have a **science background and want to solve scientific problems with AI**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sciences**.  
- If you aim to **become an innovator/entrepreneur using AI**, choose **MSc AI-Driven Innovation**.

---

### **How much should you pay?**
The retrieved context does **not include tuition fee information** for the above AI programmes. However, you can expect fees similar to other CityUHK taught postgraduate programmes (e.g., MSc Cybersecurity: HK$10,800–$12,300 per credit; MSc Finance: HK$11,700 per credit).  

**To get exact fees:**  
- Visit the official programme website for each programme.  
- Note that the **MSc AI** and **MSc AI in Business** programmes offer scholarships (as highlighted above) – check eligibility for fee reduction.  

For a general idea, most CityUHK MSc programmes require 30–36 credits, so total tuition could range from **~HK$324,000 to ~HK$421,000** (based on HK$10,800–$11,700 per credit), but this is an estimate only. Confirm with the latest fee schedule available on the CityUHK website.

Based on your interest in AI, CityUHK offers several specialized programmes. Below are the best matches with explanations, comparisons, and fee guidance.

---

### **Programme 1: MSc Artificial Intelligence (P75)**
**Why it fits:**
- This is the most direct and comprehensive AI programme, designed specifically for computer professionals who want to strengthen technical capabilities in AI.
- Covers core AI topics (10 credits) and a wide range of electives (21 credits), with optional streams in **Autonomous Driving**, **Generative AI**, and **Trustworthy AI**—allowing you to specialize.
- Prepares you for research, advanced development, or further AI studies.
- Eligible for the **Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship** (for local students under STEM priority).

**Best for:** Someone with a computing background who wants deep technical AI expertise.

---

### **Programme 2: MSc Artificial Intelligence in Business (P85)**
**Why it fits:**
- Designed for students with IT/IS or business backgrounds to build a holistic “AI + business” mindset.
- Combines AI core courses (e.g., Generative AI for Business, AI Ethics) with business core courses (e.g., Fintech, Marketing Analytics, People Analytics).
- Emphasizes using AI to improve efficiency, manage AI projects, and drive digital transformation.
- Offers a **HK$50,000 scholarship** for outstanding applicants and is also eligible for the UGC Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship (Digital priority).

**Best for:** Someone interested in applying AI to solve business problems and take on management/technical roles.

---

### **Programme 3: MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sciences (P79)**
**Why it fits:**
- Provides rigorous AI foundational training while enabling interdisciplinary knowledge across various scientific fields.
- Core courses include Statistical Machine Learning, Generative AI, and AI for Scientific Knowledge Discovery.
- Offers four tracks (e.g., AI for Scientific Discovery) to align with your scientific interests.
- Prepares graduates to develop novel AI algorithms and apply them to challenges in sciences and research.

**Best for:** Someone with a science background (or interest in science) who wants to use AI for research and innovation.

---

### **Programme 4: MSc AI-Driven Innovation (P89)**
**Why it fits:**
- Focuses on AI as both an **enabler** of innovation (using AI tools) and an **intelligent feature** in new products/services.
- Core courses cover Technological Innovation & Entrepreneurship, Design Science, and AI concepts/application.
- Emphasises systems design thinking and entrepreneurial leadership – ideal for leading the 4th Industrial Revolution.
- Electives allow you to tailor your learning toward innovation-driven projects.

**Best for:** Someone who wants to become a leader in technology innovation and entrepreneurship, blending AI with design and business strategy.

---

### **Comparison when multiple options exist**

| Aspect | MSc AI | MSc AI in Business | MSc AI for Sciences | MSc AI-Driven Innovation |
|--------|--------|-------------------|-------------------|--------------------------|
| **Primary focus** | Technical AI depth | AI + business management | AI + scientific research | AI + innovation/entrepreneurship |
| **Target background** | Computing / IT | IT/IS or business | Science / engineering | Any background with innovation interest |
| **Course structure** | Core + electives (with streams) | AI core + business core + electives | Core + track electives | Core + electives |
| **Scholarships** | UGC STEM Scholarship | UGC Digital Scholarship + HK$50,000 | Not mentioned | Not mentioned |

**Recommendation:**  
- If you want **the most technical, AI-specialised programme**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence**.  
- If you prefer **applying AI to business and leadership**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence in Business**.  
- If you have a **science background and want to solve scientific problems with AI**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sciences**.  
- If you aim to **become an innovator/entrepreneur using AI**, choose **MSc AI-Driven Innovation**.

---

### **How much should you pay?**
The retrieved context does **not include tuition fee information** for the above AI programmes. However, you can expect fees similar to other CityUHK taught postgraduate programmes (e.g., MSc Cybersecurity: HK$10,800–$12,300 per credit; MSc Finance: HK$11,700 per credit).  

**To get exact fees:**  
- Visit the official programme website for each programme.  
- Note that the **MSc AI** and **MSc AI in Business** programmes offer scholarships (as highlighted above) – check eligibility for fee reduction.  

For a general idea, most CityUHK MSc programmes require 30–36 credits, so total tuition could range from **~HK$324,000 to ~HK$421,000** (based on HK$10,800–$11,700 per credit), but this is an estimate only. Confirm with the latest fee schedule available on the CityUHK website.

Based on your interest in AI, CityUHK offers several specialized programmes. Below are the best matches with explanations, comparisons, and fee guidance.

---

### **Programme 1: MSc Artificial Intelligence (P75)**
**Why it fits:**
- This is the most direct and comprehensive AI programme, designed specifically for computer professionals who want to strengthen technical capabilities in AI.
- Covers core AI topics (10 credits) and a wide range of electives (21 credits), with optional streams in **Autonomous Driving**, **Generative AI**, and **Trustworthy AI**—allowing you to specialize.
- Prepares you for research, advanced development, or further AI studies.
- Eligible for the **Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship** (for local students under STEM priority).

**Best for:** Someone with a computing background who wants deep technical AI expertise.

---

### **Programme 2: MSc Artificial Intelligence in Business (P85)**
**Why it fits:**
- Designed for students with IT/IS or business backgrounds to build a holistic “AI + business” mindset.
- Combines AI core courses (e.g., Generative AI for Business, AI Ethics) with business core courses (e.g., Fintech, Marketing Analytics, People Analytics).
- Emphasizes using AI to improve efficiency, manage AI projects, and drive digital transformation.
- Offers a **HK$50,000 scholarship** for outstanding applicants and is also eligible for the UGC Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship (Digital priority).

**Best for:** Someone interested in applying AI to solve business problems and take on management/technical roles.

---

### **Programme 3: MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sciences (P79)**
**Why it fits:**
- Provides rigorous AI foundational training while enabling interdisciplinary knowledge across various scientific fields.
- Core courses include Statistical Machine Learning, Generative AI, and AI for Scientific Knowledge Discovery.
- Offers four tracks (e.g., AI for Scientific Discovery) to align with your scientific interests.
- Prepares graduates to develop novel AI algorithms and apply them to challenges in sciences and research.

**Best for:** Someone with a science background (or interest in science) who wants to use AI for research and innovation.

---

### **Programme 4: MSc AI-Driven Innovation (P89)**
**Why it fits:**
- Focuses on AI as both an **enabler** of innovation (using AI tools) and an **intelligent feature** in new products/services.
- Core courses cover Technological Innovation & Entrepreneurship, Design Science, and AI concepts/application.
- Emphasises systems design thinking and entrepreneurial leadership – ideal for leading the 4th Industrial Revolution.
- Electives allow you to tailor your learning toward innovation-driven projects.

**Best for:** Someone who wants to become a leader in technology innovation and entrepreneurship, blending AI with design and business strategy.

---

### **Comparison when multiple options exist**

| Aspect | MSc AI | MSc AI in Business | MSc AI for Sciences | MSc AI-Driven Innovation |
|--------|--------|-------------------|-------------------|--------------------------|
| **Primary focus** | Technical AI depth | AI + business management | AI + scientific research | AI + innovation/entrepreneurship |
| **Target background** | Computing / IT | IT/IS or business | Science / engineering | Any background with innovation interest |
| **Course structure** | Core + electives (with streams) | AI core + business core + electives | Core + track electives | Core + electives |
| **Scholarships** | UGC STEM Scholarship | UGC Digital Scholarship + HK$50,000 | Not mentioned | Not mentioned |

**Recommendation:**  
- If you want **the most technical, AI-specialised programme**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence**.  
- If you prefer **applying AI to business and leadership**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence in Business**.  
- If you have a **science background and want to solve scientific problems with AI**, choose **MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sciences**.  
- If you aim to **become an innovator/entrepreneur using AI**, choose **MSc AI-Driven Innovation**.

---

### **How much should you pay?**
The retrieved context does **not include tuition fee information** for the above AI programmes. However, you can expect fees similar to other CityUHK taught postgraduate programmes (e.g., MSc Cybersecurity: HK$10,800–$12,300 per credit; MSc Finance: HK$11,700 per credit).  

**To get exact fees:**  
- Visit the official programme website for each programme.  
- Note that the **MSc AI** and **MSc AI in Business** programmes offer scholarships (as highlighted above) – check eligibility for fee reduction.
